Our challenging offer

If you believe that your Psoriasis  is not curable, come to us, we will cure you. You can even pay after getting the result (no need to pay in the beginning of treatment) for more details regarding this offer visit our challenging offer page.   Things to follow

We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We always use high quality medicines.

  1. Normally patients will get some relaxation (itching will come down) in the first day of our treatment itself, in most cases  itching and patching may disappear in 3 to 4 weeks time..

  3. Our medications for psoriasis will help to remove toxins, inflammation, rashes, scaling, itching etc..
  4. Once  itching, rashes, patches, scaling etc…  are removed you will get back your normal skin color, and the new skin may be clean, clear and attractive.

Duration of the treatment

Normally we admit the patient and they have to undergo the panchakarma therapy for 3 to 4 weeks depends on the condition of the patient.  Most cases it may take around one month and in exceptional cases it may take more time. Even after curing, patients have to continue the medications for one to three years, we will reduce the medicines considerably after 3 to 6 months.

What is Psoriasis?

Psoriasis is an autoimmune disease which affects the skin. It is a common skin condition that causes skin redness and irritation. It occurs when the immune system mistakes the skin cells as a pathogen, and sends out faulty signals that speed up the growth cycle of skin cells. Most people with psoriasis have thick, red skin with flaky, silver-white patches called scales. It is not contagious and you cannot spread it to others. It may be hereditary. There are five types of psoriasis: plaque, guttate, inverse, pustular, and erythrodermic. Modern medicinal system tells that it is not curable. Ayurvedic treatments will help you to cure it, rare cases there is chance for coming again, but you treat it immediately with our medicine, it will be cured in a short time. The quality of life of patients with psoriasis is often diminished because of the appearance of their skin. People with psoriasis are more likely to have diabetes, high blood lipids, and heart disease.  We have solutions for all these problems.

How to boost your immune

After taking treatment and medicines from us your immune system will be much better than before.  You have to keep it.  Everybody knows that the use of antibiotics and number of other medicines will harming your immune system.  Naturally you too have normal problems like, fever, cough, cold etc…  If you have any such issues use our medicines, which will solve your problem much faster than the other medicines and keeps your immune better and better.  After the treatment we will ad.  Your family members too can use these medicines if they have cough, cold etc…
